description: Corporate Cyberspace , also known as Corporate Gen-X Cyber , prominent between roughly 1993 and 2000, is an aesthetic that blends sterile digital blues, stock photography, an optimistic corporate view of the early Internet, and wireframe graphics, which represents how big business was first imagined through the digital frontier as shiny, clean, and professional, dominated by sterile whites, deep navy blues, translucent neon blue, chrome silvers, or purple grid lines, floating polygonal globes, Early 3D wireframe tunnels, low-poly office renders and abstract data streams. It bridged the gap from Memphis Lite and Early Cyber to Y2K Futurism and Gen X Soft Club .
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Corporate-Maximalism, Optimism
